text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho's selfishness had become well 
known even among the racetrack staff, 
leading them to stay on high alert, 
worrying she might skip the post-race 
concert entirely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Trainer firmly stated that 
everything would be fine. Overhearing 
this, Sweep Tosho didn't show up late and 
put on a flawless live performance.
